_comment: Migration shape spike fixture seed (SPEC-056 D6/D6a/P7 edge rules, task task-skill-research-migration-shape-spike-read-only-corpus-copy, plan plan-implementation-spec-056-phase-execution-model-strategy-a, captured 2026-07-19). READ-ONLY analysis of a temp COPY of the live corpus's 167 task docs (see live-corpus-census.json in this directory for the raw census) seeded this fixture's REALISTIC baseline shapes; the edge-case scenarios required by SPEC-056 AC-P-5 (legacy_phase residue, multi-claim collapse, >50-merged-evidence, empty declared phase) do NOT occur in the current live corpus (0/167 tasks carry legacy_phase; max single-task evidence count is 16; no plan has an unreferenced declared phase) and are therefore SYNTHESIZED here, deliberately combined with the live-observed shapes so the future PhaseMigrationService test suite (SPEC-056 P2/P3) has one self-contained fixture covering every distinct extra-key shape plus every P7 edge rule in a single 3-plan/10-task corpus. DocRecord-shaped (id/slug/type/role/title/status/priority/content/parent_id/extra/tags/version/created_at/updated_at/created_by/deleted_at) — insert directly into an InMemoryStore or a throwaway SQLite copy for a migration dry-run test. Deterministic fixed timestamps throughout (July 2026) — never Date.now().

scenario_index.expect: claim is DROPPED from the merged phase doc's `claim` field; recorded as a `track` note naming the displaced holder+branch+at

scenario_index.edge_rule: P7 multi-claim collapse (winning/newer holder) + D6 >50-entry merged evidence cap
scenario_index.expect: claim SURVIVES on the merged phase doc; merged evidence = 20(A1)+35(A2) = 55 entries, ALL present with `origin` set to their source task id, NEVER truncated
grouped under a phase named from `legacy_phase` ('old-build-track'), since `phase` is absent

scenario_index.edge_rule: baseline — grouped under declared 'docs' phase, minimal fields
scenario_index.expect: phase doc with no claim, no evidence, no anchors

scenario_index.edge_rule: P7 empty declared phase ('ghost' — zero referencing tasks)
scenario_index.expect: an EMPTY phase doc is still created for 'ghost' (declared intent is data, not noise)

scenario_index.edge_rule: baseline — mixed file+dir-scope anchors, mixed ac_ref/attestation/legacy-bare evidence
scenario_index.expect: anchor list byte-equal after migration; evidence entries preserve ac_ref/attestation exactly, each gains `origin`
merges into 'core' phase doc contributing nothing but its existence

scenario_index.edge_rule: P7 one-phase-per-task fallback (no phase, no legacy_phase at all)
scenario_index.expect: becomes its OWN phase doc (not grouped with any other task)

scenario_index.edge_rule: SPEC-039 §M2 attestation.first_seen shape preserved through merge
scenario_index.expect: the single evidence entry's `attestation.first_seen: true` survives byte-identical, plus gains `origin`

scenario_index.edge_rule: D6 boundary — 49 entries, SOLO (no merge partner), stays under the 50-cap
scenario_index.expect: all 49 entries present with `origin` set; distinct from the Alpha OVER-cap merged case
becomes its own phase doc (no phase field -> one-phase-per-task fallback)

scenario_index.edge_rule: P7 empty declared phase, SECOND independent instance ('orphan')
scenario_index.expect: empty phase doc created; proves the empty-declared-phase rule generalizes across plans

scenario_index.edge_rule: P7 one-phase-per-task fallback (live-census signature #4: plan_id+verification_evidence only)
scenario_index.expect: becomes its own phase doc; evidence entries gain `origin`

scenario_index.edge_rule: baseline — live-census signature #7 (claim+file_anchors+phase, no evidence yet)
scenario_index.expect: claim carries straight through (no collapse partner in 'solo'); anchor list byte-equal

scenario_index.edge_rule: baseline — live-census signature #8 (file_anchors+phase, no claim, no evidence)
scenario_index.expect: merges into 'solo' phase doc contributing only its anchor list

plans.title: Fixture Plan Alpha — legacy_phase residue + multi-claim + evidence-cap
plans.content: Fixture-only plan doc. Declares 3 phases; 'ghost' is deliberately never referenced by any task (P7 empty-declared-phase edge rule).

phases.name: build
phases.description: core build phase — 2 tasks collapse into this group (multi-claim scenario)

phases.name: ghost
phases.description: declared but never referenced by any task — must migrate to an EMPTY phase doc, not be dropped

plans.title: Fixture Plan Beta — anchor variety + no-phase-field vintage task
plans.content: Fixture-only plan doc. Single declared phase 'core'; one task (B3) predates SPEC-023 entirely and carries neither `phase` nor `legacy_phase` — one-phase-per-task migration fallback.

plans.title: Fixture Plan Gamma — near-cap solo evidence + second empty-declared-phase instance
plans.content: Fixture-only plan doc. 'orphan' phase declared but never referenced (second independent empty-declared-phase instance, distinct plan from Alpha's 'ghost') — proves the rule generalizes, not a one-off.

phases.name: solo
phases.description: solo phase — EXACTLY one task, evidence near the 50 cap but SOLO so no merge-overflow

phases.name: extra
phases.description: second non-empty phase — freshly-claimed + not-started signature coverage

phases.name: orphan
phases.description: declared, zero referencing tasks — must still migrate to an empty phase doc

tasks.title: Alpha/build — displaced claim holder (older fresh claim, loses to A2)
tasks.content: Fixture task. Holds an OLDER fresh claim than task-alpha-build-holder-winner (A2) on the SAME plan+phase group. Per SPEC-056 P7: when multiple fresh claims collapse into one phase-group, the NEWEST fresh claim wins the phase claim and displaced holders are recorded as `track` notes (loud in the migration report).

tasks.title: Alpha/build — winning claim holder (newer fresh claim); merged evidence exceeds 50-cap
tasks.content: Fixture task. Holds a NEWER fresh claim than A1 in the same plan+phase group — wins the merged phase claim per P7. Its 35 evidence entries + A1's 20 = 55 total when merged, exceeding the per-doc 50-entry cap. Per SPEC-056 D6: the cap is PER-SOURCE-TASK preserved via an evidence `origin` marker on each entry — merged entries are NEVER truncated to fit under 50 on the destination phase doc.

tasks.title: Alpha — legacy_phase residue (pre-SPEC-023 vintage, no extra.phase)
tasks.content: Fixture task. Carries ONLY `extra.legacy_phase` (SPEC-023 `lore migrate phases` residue) — NO `extra.phase`. Per SPEC-056 D6/P7: `legacy_phase` is honored as a grouping-key FALLBACK when `phase` is absent.

tasks.title: Alpha/docs — bare task (no claim, no evidence, no anchors)
tasks.content: Fixture task. Minimal shape: only `plan_id`+`phase`. Represents the large no-claim/no-evidence/no-anchor population found live (114/167 tasks have no anchors; 37/167 have no evidence).

tasks.title: Beta/core — mixed file+directory-scope anchors, mixed oracle evidence
tasks.content: Fixture task. `file_anchors` mixes a file-level path and a directory-scope path (trailing `/`, SPEC-042 grammar). Evidence mixes ac_ref-bound, attestation-bound, and one legacy bare (no ac_ref/no attestation) entry — realistic pre/post-SPEC-038/039 mix as seen live.

tasks.title: Beta/core — untouched draft (no anchors, no evidence, no claim)
tasks.content: Fixture task. Never worked: bare `plan_id`+`phase` only, status draft.

tasks.title: Beta — pre-SPEC-023 vintage task (neither phase nor legacy_phase)
tasks.content: Fixture task. Carries `plan_id` + evidence + anchors but NO `phase` and NO `legacy_phase` at all — predates the SPEC-023 phase field entirely. Per SPEC-056 P7 grouping rule: 'grouped by extra.phase where declared, ELSE ONE PHASE PER TASK'.

tasks.title: Beta/core — single evidence entry with attestation.first_seen=true
tasks.content: Fixture task. Exactly one evidence entry, carrying `attestation.first_seen: true` (SPEC-039 §M2 command-provenance annotation) — isolates the first_seen shape from the larger mixed blocks above.

tasks.title: Gamma/solo — 49 evidence entries (near the 50-cap, SOLO in its phase group)
tasks.content: Fixture task. Sole task in the 'solo' phase group — its 49 evidence entries stay under the 50-cap after migration (no merge partner), distinct from Plan Alpha's OVER-cap MERGED scenario (A1+A2=55).

tasks.title: Gamma — untouched draft, no phase field, no evidence, no anchors, no claim
tasks.content: Fixture task. Minimal possible shape: only `plan_id`. Matches the live census's simplest signature `(plan_id,)`.

tasks.title: Gamma — evidence but no phase field and no anchors
tasks.content: Fixture task. `(plan_id, verification_evidence)` shape — live-census signature #4 (e.g. task-fix-export-human-id-file-path-collision-repair-index): a task worked and evidenced before it was ever assigned a declared phase.

tasks.title: Gamma/solo — freshly claimed, anchors declared, no evidence yet
tasks.content: Fixture task. `(claim, file_anchors, phase, plan_id)` shape — live-census signature #7 (e.g. task-skill-test-core-contracts-red-scenarios): work just started, claim+anchors declared, no oracle evidence recorded yet. FRESH claim, no collapse partner in this phase group.

tasks.title: Gamma/orphan-adjacent — anchors + phase declared, not yet started (no evidence, no claim)
tasks.content: Fixture task. `(file_anchors, phase, plan_id)` shape — live-census signature #8: anchors and a phase assignment exist (declared scope) but no claim was ever taken and no evidence recorded.
